finding: The Danish national screening program for SGA based on selective EFW on clinical indication has improved considerably over the last 20 years, but limitations include a large proportion of women referred to ultrasound and low performance post-term.
mod_finding: False diagnosis of small-for-gestational-age (SGA) was associated with an increased rate of induction of labor and cesarean section.
birth_weight: birthweight ≤-22% of expected for gestational age
